Q2 Product Update

This demo post shows what a synced Google Doc looks like in WordPress. In a real workflow, Brasth Document Sync for Google Docs imports content directly from Google Docs, including headings, lists, tables, and images.

What is new

  • One-way sync from Google Docs to WordPress posts and pages.
  • Background sync with WP-Cron and diagnostic logs.
  • Optional Elementor layout support.

Roadmap
